newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Novellus cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Novellus cut to neutral.

text.p: -- PaineWebber said it downgraded Novellus Systems Inc to neutral from attractive.
-- company said Monday it will seek to overturn a patent infringement jury verdict against it in U.S. federal court in California.
-- also said potential damages could have a material adverse impact on its financial condition.
-- analyst Gunnar Miller said patent verdict in favor of Applied Materials Inc was a "psychological blow" to Novellus.
-- "Uncertainty surrounding potential damages likely to cast near-term cloud over Novellus," he said in a research report.
-- added that "financial impact likely to be limited, but negative psychological impact could be more pronounced."
